The head of Hogwarts is Albus Dumbledore.
Harry goes to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
Hermione is known for being very smart.
Ron is Harry’s best friend.
Voldemort is an evil dark wizard.
Professor Snape teaches Potions.
The four houses are Gryffindor, Slytherin, Hufflepuff, and Ravenclaw.
Harry is the Seeker on the Gryffindor team.
The Time-Turner lets people travel back in time.
The train leaves from Platform 9¾.
Hogsmeade is special because only wizards live there.
Dobby is a house-elf.
Dementors take away happy feelings.
Harry uses the spell Expecto Patronum.
He is called “The Boy Who Lived.”
Horcruxes hide pieces of Voldemort’s soul.
Buckbeak is a hippogriff.
The Marauder’s Map shows where people are inside Hogwarts.
The Sorting Hat chooses the right house for each student.
The Philosopher’s Stone can give someone long life.
